# Jagran Josh

> > India's leading education portal providing comprehensive coverage of board exam results, government job notifications, entrance exam preparation, and academic news across CBSE, state boards, and competitive examinations.

Jagran Josh serves millions of Indian students and job seekers with real-time updates on exam schedules, admit cards, results, recruitment notifications, and study materials. The platform covers major educational bodies including NCERT, RBSE, CBSE, state boards, and recruitment agencies like RRB, OPSC, and various police departments.

## Key Topics

- Board Exam Results (RBSE, CBSE, State Boards)
- Government Job Notifications
- Admit Card Downloads
- Entrance Exam Preparation (JEE Main, NEET, Agniveer)
- Exam Schedule & Important Dates
- NCERT & Educational Updates
- Competitive Exam Cut-offs
- Recruitment Notifications (RRB, PSC, Police)
- Question Papers & Answer Keys
- Study Materials & MCQs
- Rajasthan Board (RBSE)
- Indian Army & Defense Recruitment
- Public Service Commission Exams
- University Exam Updates
